claim_text: A liquid filtration unit comprising a housing defining an inlet and an outlet; a pleated membrane cartridge positioned between the inlet and the outlet; a coarse mesh screen upstream of the cartridge; a pressure sensor configured to measure pressure on each side of the cartridge; and a controller configured to open a bypass valve when the pressure difference across the cartridge exceeds a stored threshold.
answer_text: Yes. Paragraphs [001] and [002] disclose the claimed filtration arrangement and the pressure-difference-controlled bypass valve, including the stated threshold condition.
question_text: Does this single prior-art document disclose every limitation of the claimed liquid filtration unit?

cited_evidence.quote_text: The filtration unit has a housing with an inlet and an outlet. A pleated membrane cartridge is positioned between them, and a coarse mesh screen is installed upstream of the cartridge.
cited_evidence.claim_feature: The housing inlet and outlet, intervening pleated membrane cartridge, and upstream coarse mesh screen.

cited_evidence.quote_text: A pressure sensor measures pressure at both the inlet and outlet sides of the cartridge. The controller compares the pressure difference with a stored threshold and opens a bypass valve when the difference exceeds that threshold.
cited_evidence.claim_feature: The sensor measures pressure on both sides of the cartridge, and the controller opens the bypass valve when the pressure difference exceeds a stored threshold.
